THE X-MEN QUESTION, CHECKED AND DECLINED: nothing in this bio (or anywhere else in the held JWA corpus) connects Banshee to Marvel's X-Men character of the same name — no mutant powers, no sonic scream, no Irish nationality, no X-Men reference of any kind; the name is the shared, independently-common mythological "banshee" (a wailing Irish folklore spirit), reused by wrestling gimmicks widely and, elsewhere in this very registry, by an unrelated LCW wrestler's own unminted manager credit ("Banshee" alongside Sean Fein, an Irish-themed 1997 LCW roster entry) and by a wholly separate RSPWF Top 200 poll entry (banshee-rspwf, #150 in 1998, tagged G-Pro/SJPW — no tenure, no shared fed, filed distinct on name alone). Neither collision shows any evidence of connection to this Banshee and both are filed distinct.

THE STRONGER FINDING: the held BEW corpus (promotions/bew/archive/night-of-armageddon.html and its own card/participants pages) independently stages a "Banshee" at BEW's own "Night of Armageddon" — long white hair, pale skin, a surcoat removed before the match, black tights with a gothic cross on each leg — squaring the bio's own physical description ("pale skin, long white hair... gothic cross down the length of each leg") almost exactly, in a BEW Hardcore Title match ("Banshee -vs- An Immature Child," promotions/bew/archive/night-of-armageddon-card.html) that matches this bio's own self-billed "BEW Hardcore Champion" claim. BEW's own text later calls Banshee an M.o.A. member outright, in the same roster call-outs naming Redemption, Matt Attic, Mass Carnage and Tommy Riley — names this JWA wing's own Dark Justice corpus independently stages as a M.o.A. incursion three months later.
